drugMinimumMonths.condition: 21USC841(b)(1)(B) specified substance/quantity; no qualifying prior conviction or death/serious-bodily-injury enhancement; exceptions not yet fully resolved

firearmMinimumMonths.condition: 18USC924(c)(1)(A), qualifying federal predicate offense; greater-minimum proviso and exceptions require full treatment

924cPriorFinalConviction.scope: 18USC924(c)(1)(C)(i); prior conviction under this subsection must already be final; special-firearm life provision not represented by numeric months

readFacts.924cConsecutive: 18USC924(c)(1)(D)(ii) bars concurrent service with another imprisonment term
readFacts.841PriorEnhancements: 21USC841(b)(1)(A): one qualifying final prior serious drug/violent felony ->15years;two or more ->25years. SubparagraphB:qualifying prior ->10years. Offense and enhancements must remain separate.
readFacts.safetyValve: 18USC3553(f) court findings may permit sentencing without statutory minimum for listed drug offenses; criminal history, violence/firearm, death/injury, leadership and truthful-disclosure criteria must all be examined.
